source: sshb.sql (database `sshb`, dumped 2024-06-10) from https://github.com/smabdulmueid97/Online-Food-Ordering-Delivery-System — tables `products` + `catagory`. Prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (Tk.), exactly as in the PHP pages (single_product.php / all_product.php show 'Tk.'). Names trimmed of leading/trailing spaces only; descriptions verbatim from SQL, including the garbled test description on id 30.

products.name: Rice and Chicken Curry
products.description: A classic combination where rice is served with a flavorful chicken curry, typically made with a mix of spices, tomatoes, and onions.

products.name: Khichuri
products.description: A popular South Asian dish made with rice and lentils. It can include vegetables and is often seasoned with spices like turmeric, cumin, and bay leaves.

products.name: Alu Bhorta
products.description: A Bangladeshi mashed potato dish flavored with mustard oil, green chilies, and onions.

products.name: Roti with Beef Curry
products.description: Roti is a type of flatbread made from whole wheat flour, and it is often served with a spicy and rich beef curry.

products.name: Dal Bhat
products.description: A traditional South Asian meal consisting of lentil soup (dal) and rice (bhat).

products.name: Luchi with Aloo Dom
products.description: Luchi is a deep-fried flatbread made from refined flour, often served with Aloo Dom, a spicy potato curry.

products.name: jilapi
products.description: A sweet, deep-fried dessert made from a batter of wheat flour, which is then soaked in sugar syrup. Also known as jalebi.

products.name: Fish fry
products.description: Fish fillets or whole fish coated in a spiced batter or breading and deep-fried until crispy.

products.name: beef
products.description: Grilled or barbecued beef, typically marinated in spices and cooked over an open flame.

products.name: BBQ
products.description:
BBQ - the sweet and tangy flavors of a perfectly grilled or smoked meat, infused with the rich aromas of spices and herbs. Whether it's a tender rack of ribs, a juicy burger, or a slow-cooked brisket, BBQ is a culinary delight that's sure to tantalize the taste buds.

The sweet and tangy flavors of the BBQ sauce mingle with the rich flavors of the meat, creating a harmonious balance of flavors that's both familiar and comforting. The aroma of smoked meat wafts through the air, teasing the senses and leaving you craving more.

products.name: Rice & Fish
products.description: A staple meal in many parts of the world, particularly in South Asia, where rice is paired with a variety of fish preparations.

products.name: Somosa
products.description: A fried or baked pastry with a savory filling, such as spiced potatoes, peas, and sometimes meat.

products.name: Singara
products.description: Similar to samosas, singaras are filled pastries, often with a spiced potato and pea filling, popular in Bengal.

products.name: Beef Somosa
products.description: A variation of the samosa filled with spiced ground beef.

products.name: Puri
products.description: A deep-fried bread made from unleavened wheat flour dough, often served with a variety of side dishes.

products.name: Regular Cake
products.description: Can come in various flavors and styles, such as sponge cakes, layer cakes, etc.
